name: code-review
title: Code Review
summary: Run an autonomous code review of the workspace (or subset) using the coordination system with repo-specific review profile context. Produces severity-ordered findings with file:line references and optionally generates fix tasks for user approval.
when_to_use: When you need to audit the codebase for architectural issues, risk zones, or cross-module contract violations
When you want automated review aligned with this repo's invariants and review profile
When you need a persistent review document with findings organized by severity
When you want optional fix generation for the identified issues

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Review scope: worktree (default), diff <base>, paths <glob>, or globs <pattern1,pattern2,...>

inputs.name: dimensions
inputs.description: Comma-separated review dimensions to apply: correctness, error-handling, concurrency, security, performance, maintainability, code_quality, comment_accuracy, test_coverage, type_design, simplification, architecture. Defaults to correctness + error-handling + concurrency + security + performance + maintainability.

inputs.name: fix_mode
inputs.description: Whether to generate fix tasks: 'generate' creates fix tasks for user approval, 'report' (default) produces findings only.

steps: SurveyWorkspace: Run cargo check, cargo clippy, cargo test, cargo fmt --check to capture repo context
PlanCodeReview: Read survey artifact + review-profile.md + user-supplied scope, validate profile freshness (warn if >30 days stale), output ordered list of read-only ReviewArtifacts tasks
ReviewArtifacts (one per chunk, max 2000 LOC each): Apply selected dimensions with repo-specific criteria from review profile, output findings in JSON contract
Optional Fix Tasks: Only when fix_mode=generate, generate fix tasks requiring user approval
MaterializeDesignDoc: Aggregate all review artifacts into severity-ordered markdown document at docs/code-review-YYYY-MM-DD.md
outputs: Review document: docs/code-review-YYYY-MM-DD.md with severity-ordered findings and file:line references
Findings JSON contract from each ReviewArtifacts task
Optional fix tasks for user approval (when fix_mode=generate)
